gloss: deterrent; deterrent force; power of deterrence

definitions.gloss: deterrent; deterrent force; power of deterrence
definitions.explanation: The power or capability to discourage or prevent an action, especially military aggression or criminal behavior, by making the consequences unacceptable.

examples.japanese: {核|かく}の{抑止力|よくしりょく}について{議論|ぎろん}した。
{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラは{犯罪|はんざい}の{抑止力|よくしりょく}になる。
examples.english: Security cameras serve as a crime deterrent.

examples.japanese: {同盟国|どうめいこく}との{協力|きょうりょく}によって{抑止力|よくしりょく}を{強化|きょうか}する{方針|ほうしん}が{示|しめ}された。
examples.english: A policy was announced to strengthen deterrence through cooperation with allied nations.

notes:
FORMS:
{抑止|よくし} (deterrence, suppression) + {力|りょく} (power, force).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核|かく}{抑止力|よくしりょく} (nuclear deterrence)
- {抑止力|よくしりょく}を{高|たか}める (to increase deterrent power)
- {抑止力|よくしりょく}として{機能|きのう}する (to function as a deterrent)
- {犯罪|はんざい}の{抑止力|よくしりょく} (crime deterrent)

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news reporting about defense policy, international relations, and security. Also used in everyday contexts for crime prevention measures.
